## T2: Mechanical accelerator

A massless thread makes $N$ turns around statically fixed cylinder, as shown in the figure. Initially, the free (unwound) ends of the thread are parallel to the axis $X$. Then, a heavy point-like object $P$ is attached to one end of the thread while the other end is pulled with a constant velocity $u$ along $X$. Find the maximum velocity attained by the heavy object.

<image_1>

The thread is inextendable and flexible. Suppose that the turns of the thread are wound tightly to one another and are placed practically in the same plane, perpendicular to the cylinder axis. Neglect any friction in the system. Do not consider the force of gravity.

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there is a fixed cylinder, and a thin string is tightly wound many turns around the outside of the cylinder; beside it, brackets mark the number of turns as N. The left free end is connected to a small heavy object P, and the right free end is pulled along the horizontal X direction, with an arrow marking the pulling speed as u. The free line segments at the two ends are both approximately horizontal along the X direction in the initial state. Reasoning: Let the cylinder radius be R, and let θ denote the total wrapping angle that has already been unwound and swept through starting from the side of the heavy object P. Since there are N turns in total, the range of θ is from 0 to 2πN. The thin string is inextensible and frictionless; when the right end is pulled out by a small segment ds = u dt at speed u, the contact point on the cylinder advances along the circumferential direction by arc length R dθ, therefore R dθ = u dt, that is, dθ/dt = u/R. The heavy object P is located at the endpoint of the taut string released from the tangency point of the cylinder, and its trajectory can be regarded as the involute of a circle; according to involute geometry, the endpoint displacement increment is dS_P = R(1 + θ)dθ. Therefore the speed of the heavy object is v_P = dS_P/dt = R(1 + θ)(dθ/dt) = u(1 + θ). This speed increases monotonically with θ, so the maximum speed is obtained when all N turns have participated in unwinding, that is, θ = 2πN. Therefore the maximum speed is v_max = u(2πN + 1).

method.method_draft: 先读图像：图中固定圆柱外绕有标为 N 的多圈细线，左端自由段连到质点 P，右端自由段沿水平 X 方向被以速度 u 拉动；两自由段在图示初态都近似沿 X 方向。再读题文：线不可伸长、无摩擦、质量可忽略，N 圈紧密且近似在同一垂直于圆柱轴的平面内。设圆柱半径为 R，令 θ 为已经从质点端对应展开/扫过的总包角，范围从 0 到 2πN。右端每拉出一小段 ds=u dt，就等价于使接触点沿圆柱周向前进 R dθ，因此 dθ/dt=u/R。质点 P 是一根从圆柱切点放出的紧线端点，其轨迹可按圆的渐开线处理；对渐开线微分，端点的位移增量为 dS_P=R(1+θ)dθ。于是 v_P=dS_P/dt=u(1+θ)。该表达式随 θ 单调增大，所以最大值在全部 N 圈参与、θ=2πN 时取得，得到 v_max=u(2πN+1)。

method.method_draft: 先读图像：P 在圆柱左侧，细线绕圆柱 N 圈后从右侧伸出，并被沿 X 方向以速度 u 拉；图示自由段都是水平切向段。再读题文：线不可伸长且无摩擦，所以拉动右端会把同样的线长以速率 u 送入/送出圆柱接触区，圆柱只改变线的方向。设当前已经有效展开的包角为 θ。由于每展开角 dθ 对应圆周长度 R dθ，接触几何的角速度为 Ω=dθ/dt=u/R。此时连接 P 的自由直线段长度等于已经展开出的圆周长度 Rθ。P 的速度可看成两部分叠加：线本身沿切线传递的速度 u，以及由于切线方向绕固定圆柱转动而给线端带来的速度 Ω·Rθ=uθ；在图示的平行自由端构型中，求最大时这两部分同向贡献。因此 v_P=u+uθ=u(1+θ)。θ 最大为总绕角 2πN，故 v_max=u(2πN+1)。
method.CoT_raw:
先描述图像：图中有一个固定的圆柱，细线在圆柱外侧紧密绕了 N 圈；左侧自由端连接重物 P，右侧自由端水平伸出，并沿标出的 X 方向以恒定速度 u 被拉动。图中左右两段未绕在圆柱上的细线都是沿 X 方向的水平切向段。

再推理：细线不可伸长、无摩擦，圆柱只改变细线方向，不损失速度传递。设圆柱半径为 R，当前从 P 一侧有效展开的包角为 θ。每展开角度 dθ，就有长度 R dθ 的细线从圆柱上展开；由于右端以速度 u 拉动，展开速率满足 R dθ/dt = u，因此 Ω = dθ/dt = u/R。

此时连接 P 的自由直线段长度等于已展开的圆周长度，即 l = Rθ。P 的速度可分为两部分：一部分是细线沿自身切向传递的速度 u；另一部分来自切线方向绕固定圆柱转动，长度为 Rθ 的自由段端点因此获得速度 Ω·Rθ = (u/R)Rθ = uθ。图示构型中，在速度达到最大时这两部分方向相同，所以 v_P = u + uθ = u(1 + θ)。

总绕角最大为 θ_max = 2πN，因此重物最大速度为 v_max = u(1 + 2πN)。

A massless thread makes $N$ turns around a statically fixed cylinder, as shown in the figure. Initially, the free (unwound) ends of the thread are parallel to the axis $X$. Then, a heavy point-like object $P$ is attached to one end of the thread while the other end is pulled with a constant velocity $u$ along $X$. Find the maximum velocity attained by the heavy object.

The thread is inextendable and flexible. Suppose that the turns of the thread are wound tightly to one another and are placed practically in the same plane, perpendicular to the cylinder axis. Neglect any friction in the system. Do not consider the force of gravity.
raw_record.final_cot:
Image description: In the figure there is a fixed cylinder, and a thin string is tightly wound many turns around the outside of the cylinder; beside it, brackets mark the number of turns as N. The left free end is connected to a small heavy object P, and the right free end is pulled along the horizontal X direction, with an arrow marking the pulling speed as u. The free line segments at the two ends are both approximately horizontal along the X direction in the initial state.

Reasoning: Let the cylinder radius be R, and let θ denote the total wrapping angle that has already been unwound and swept through starting from the side of the heavy object P. Since there are N turns in total, the range of θ is from 0 to 2πN. The thin string is inextensible and frictionless; when the right end is pulled out by a small segment ds = u dt at speed u, the contact point on the cylinder advances along the circumferential direction by arc length R dθ, therefore R dθ = u dt, that is, dθ/dt = u/R. The heavy object P is located at the endpoint of the taut string released from the tangency point of the cylinder, and its trajectory can be regarded as the involute of a circle; according to involute geometry, the endpoint displacement increment is dS_P = R(1 + θ)dθ. Therefore the speed of the heavy object is v_P = dS_P/dt = R(1 + θ)(dθ/dt) = u(1 + θ). This speed increases monotonically with θ, so the maximum speed is obtained when all N turns have participated in unwinding, that is, θ = 2πN. Therefore the maximum speed is v_max = u(2πN + 1).

推理 trace 基本通过。它先描述图像、再进行推理，满足图像题的顺序要求；图像描述中关于固定圆柱、细线绕 N 圈、左端连接 P、右端沿 X 方向以速度 u 拉动、两自由段近似水平等内容均可由题图支持。最终结果 v_max = u(1+2πN) 与标准答案一致，并且整体遵循了给定 Method Draft。可小幅改进之处是进一步明确 θ 的定义是从 P 侧已经展开或等效展开的包角，并说明 l=Rθ 来自展开圆弧长度与自由直线段长度的几何等价，以减少跳步感。
